items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: if I was not playing the lead part on a certain tune, and Cat Anderson didn’t show up, I fit in that slot.

ctx.x: What would you walk away with from that band?

First of all, when you walked into that band, you were pretty well aware of what had to be done in order to be there, regardless of who was sitting on either side of you. So it didn’t matter too much about who was sitting on either side of you, because whoever was sitting on either side of you had to be well into ways and means of fitting into Ellingtonia in Ellingtonia fashion, with Ellington-type music. So it was just like pulling out – if a battery dropped one out, you put a new battery in, but it was going to…
Is it true that it was not first trumpet or whatever, that the pieces – the roles were identified and style that he wanted?
